bio: Research Background Publications Contact Us Dr. Mondal is a trained biomedical scientist and engineer with expertise in Biomedical instrumentation and Biosensor systems for cardiorespiratory applications. His primary research interests are medical device and biomedical technology development for the study, diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular and respiratory diseases. Airway Malacia: Stent Innovations and Emerging Ex Vivo Testing Platforms. Semin Thorac Cardiovasc Surg Pediatr Card Surg Annu. 2026; 29:85-89. View Abstract
